steps.hardClue: Complete the memory game on the four computers.
steps.clue: Play one game of Samantha Says on the four computers outside the Receiving Area.

steps.hardClue: Hack a red button, then hack four terminals within sixty seconds.
steps.clue: In the Laboratories, hack a red button, then hack four green terminals within sixty seconds.

steps.hardClue: Shoot the sphere from the satellite dish with the Wonder Weapon and guide it through the map.
steps.clue: Shoot the Vril Sphere from the satellite dish with the Wave Gun and guide it to the MPD.

steps.hardClue: Fill the raised canister with zombie souls, then pull the switch to open the structure.
steps.clue: Fill the raised canister with zombie souls, then pull the switch to open the MPD and reveal Samantha.

steps.hardClue: Fill all four canisters, then insert the charged device into the pyramid.
steps.clue: Fill all four MPD canisters, then insert the charged Vril Device into the pyramid.

steps.hardClue: Complete the memory game three times, then throw a device at the sphere.
steps.clue: Play Samantha Says three times, then throw a Gersh Device at the Vril Sphere to launch the rockets.
